milestone: Package 14: license-check shipped; kit at 14 packages, 105 tests

package.name: dsh-license-check
package.decides: LICENSE shape and identity: recognized body, title matches body, copyright holder and year, no leftover template placeholders
package.distinct_rule: identification matches phrases from the license body rather than the title, so a file titled 'MIT License' whose text is the GPL is caught; BSD-3 is preferred over BSD-2 when both signatures match because BSD-3 contains BSD-2's opening

bug_notes: the honest test caught its own year regex: \b(1[89]\d{2}|20\d{2})\b could not match 2999, so a future-year fixture reported as copyright-year-missing instead of copyright-year-future. Widened to any four-digit year, which is what the rule's name promises.
quality_bar: 105 tests across the kit (11 new), audit 14/14 clean, site 15 pages, npm 0.1.0 live, and the check passes against this kit's own LICENSE file
